class.name: GameplayEffectTimeline
class.brief_description: Explicit-clock runtime for timed, stackable gameplay effects.
class.description: A reusable timeline of exact gameplay tags with positive stack counts and remaining durations. Optional periodic callbacks are accumulated in constant time and capped at 32 per tag between drains; they never directly apply damage. Bare authoritative snapshots preserve an existing periodic phase for matching effects, while full snapshots also serialize period, next_period and reset_on_reapply. Advance time through [method tick]; it never reads wall-clock time. Reapplications support refresh, extend and keep-duration policies inspired by Unreal Gameplay Effects. One timeline supports at most 256 effects, 65535 stacks per effect and durations up to seven days. Invalid or non-finite values fail without partial state changes. In multiplayer projects only an authoritative simulation may decide gameplay outcomes; client-side use should remain visual.

method.name: apply_effect
method.description: Adds stacks and applies the requested duration policy. Returns false without altering state if inputs are invalid.

method.name: set_effect
method.description: Sets an exact effect or removes it if the duration is zero.

method.name: replace_effect_branch
method.description: Atomically replaces only effects equal to or below the dotted tag [param branch]. Preserves independent durations, stacking, periodic phases and queued pulses in other branches. Effect values have the same schema and validation as [method replace_snapshot], including optional [code]period[/code], [code]next_period[/code], and [code]reset_on_reapply[/code]. A zero remaining duration removes that tag. Invalid entries, out-of-branch tags, normalized aliases, and snapshots exceeding the global cap are rejected without mutation. Pending pulses in the authoritative branch are discarded when a valid replacement commits; all unrelated pending pulses survive. An empty dictionary clears only that branch.

method.name: replace_snapshot
method.description: Atomically replaces the active effects from a dictionary mapping tags to dictionaries with remaining (seconds) and stacks (positive int). A duration of zero removes the effect.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns independent dictionaries of all active effects, safe to edit without changing the timeline.

method.name: set_periodic
method.description: Configures repeated pulses for an existing effect. Periods must be between 0.05 seconds and seven days, or zero to disable. Changing the interval resets its phase. If reset_on_reapply is true, a successful apply_effect restarts the next pulse countdown.

method.name: get_periodic
method.description: Returns an exact effect's current period, or zero if missing or disabled.

method.name: take_periodic_pulses
method.description: Returns and clears coalesced periodic trigger counts, keyed by exact tag. Each count is capped at 32 to avoid bursts after long frames. The caller chooses whether to show a visual or apply a server-authorized rule.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances by a finite positive delta; returns exact tags expiring during the tick in insertion order.

method.name: get_remaining
method.description: Returns exact effect remaining seconds, or zero.

method.name: get_stacks
method.description: Returns exact effect stacks, or zero.

method.name: has_effect
method.description: Whether the exact tag has an active effect.

method.name: remove_effect
method.description: Removes an exact effect. Returns false if absent.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: True when no effects are active.

constants.constant: Reset countdown to newly applied duration.
Extend current countdown, capped at seven days.
